method.method_draft: Horizontal-row counting route, weakly distinct: Inspect the image by rows instead of by year stacks. The bottom row has X marks for years 1 through 10, so 10 total employees are represented there; the next row has X marks for years 1 through 7, so 7 more; the next row has years 1 through 4, so 4 more; the next two rows each have years 1 through 3, so 3+3 more; and the top three rows each have only year 3, so 1+1+1 more. This gives total 10+7+4+3+3+1+1+1=30. For employees with 5 years or more, only the bottom row contributes years 5 through 10, giving 6, and the second row contributes years 5 through 7, giving 3; higher rows contribute none. Thus the target group has 6+3=9 employees, and 9/30=30%.
